definition_en: feeling regret or sympathy, sad, or in a poor state

core_image: 山谷里一声钟响，声波一圈圈传向远处的耳朵
scene: 远处传来奇怪的声音。A strange sound came from the distance.
sceneCN: 这里 sound 是「声音」（第 1 个义项）；句意：远处传来奇怪的声音。

senses.title: What you hear
senses.definition: something that can be heard
senses.definitionCN: 可以被听见的东西
senses.example: A strange sound came from the distance.
senses.why: This is the physical sense at the centre of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最核心的物理含义。

senses.title: To seem when heard
senses.definition: to give a certain impression when heard
senses.definitionCN: 被听见时给人某种印象
senses.example: That plan sounds good to me.
senses.exampleCN: 那个计划在我看来不错。
senses.why: The ear judges, so to sound became to seem.
senses.whyCN: 耳朵会作判断，于是 sound 引申为「显得」。

senses.title: Healthy and reliable
senses.definition: in good condition and able to be trusted
senses.definitionCN: 状况良好、值得信赖的
senses.example: The bridge is structurally sound.
senses.why: This sense came from a different Old English word for healthy.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项来自另一个表示健康的古英语词。

intro.en: Two old words meet in sound: one for noise, one for health.
intro.cn: 两个古老的词在 sound 中相遇：一个指声音，一个指健康。

items.en: Sonus meant a sound or a noise.
items.cn: sonus 意为声音或响声。

items.en: Son carried the word into French.
items.cn: son 把这个词带入法语。

items.en: Soun named what the ear hears.
items.cn: soun 指耳朵听到的东西。

items.en: Gesund meant healthy and whole.
items.cn: gesund 意为健康的、完好的。

items.en: The two words merged in form, giving noise and health one spelling.
items.cn: 两个词在形式上合并，使「声音」与「健康」共用一种拼写。

items.en: The verb to sound grew from the noun.
items.cn: 动词 sound 由名词发展而来。

note.en: Sound is compared with look-alike words and words for noise.
note.cn: 把 sound 与形近词以及表示声响的词作比较。

That plan sounds good to me.

abstract.en: What sounds right is not always what is sound.

abstract.en: A sound mind hears more than noise.
abstract.cn: 健全的心智听到的不只是噪音。

examples.en: A strange sound came from the distance.
That plan sounds good to me.

dict_mnemonic.text: sound 有两个来源：一个来自拉丁语 sonus（声音），一个来自古英语 gesund（健康）；sound like 是「听起来像」，safe and sound 是「安然无恙」，sound advice 是「合理的建议」。

root: 名词「声音」来自拉丁语 sonus，形容词「健全的」来自古英语 gesund，两条来源在现代英语中合流为同一拼写。

sensesIntro.en: Sound names what the ear hears, the impression it gives, and the state of being healthy.
sensesIntro.cn: sound 指耳朵听到的声音、它给人的印象，以及健全可靠的状态。

core.en: A vibration that reaches an ear.
core.cn: 抵达耳朵的振动。

branches.en: A bell shakes the quiet valley.
branches.cn: 钟声震动了安静的山谷。

branches.en: A listener tilts his head and decides.
branches.cn: 听者歪着头作出判断。

branches.en: An engineer tests a beam and nods.
branches.cn: 工程师检测横梁后点了点头。

branches.en: What reaches the ear becomes what the mind believes.
branches.cn: 传到耳朵的东西，变成心里相信的东西。

branches.en: A plan that sounds good may also be sound.
branches.cn: 听起来不错的计划，也可能确实可靠。

intro.en: Sound forms adverbs, nouns, and compounds with -ly, -ness, and -proof.
intro.cn: sound 与 -ly、-ness、-proof 构成副词、名词和复合词。

definition_en: a hot liquid food made by boiling ingredients, a thick broth, or trouble
core_image: 寒冷的冬夜，一碗冒着热气的汤放在桌上
scene: 妈妈在厨房煮了一锅热汤。Mother is cooking a pot of hot soup in the kitchen.
sceneCN: 这里 soup 是「汤」（第 1 个义项）；句意：妈妈在厨房煮了一锅热汤。

senses.title: Liquid food
senses.definition: a hot liquid food made by boiling vegetables, meat, or fish
senses.definitionCN: 把蔬菜、肉或鱼煮沸制成的热液体食物
senses.example: Mother is cooking a pot of hot soup in the kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 妈妈在厨房煮了一锅热汤。
senses.why: This is the central everyday sense of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最核心的日常含义。

senses.title: Thick broth
senses.definition: a thick, often creamy liquid dish
senses.definitionCN: 浓稠、常带奶油的液体菜肴
senses.example: The pumpkin soup was thick and sweet.
senses.why: The same dish thickens into a different texture and name.
senses.whyCN: 同样的菜变浓稠后，质地和名称也随之不同。

senses.title: Trouble
senses.definition: a difficult situation, used in the phrase in the soup
senses.definitionCN: 困难的处境，用于习语 in the soup
senses.example: Losing his job left him in the soup.
senses.why: The idiom pictures a person sunk in a thin, sticky liquid.
senses.whyCN: 这个习语把人想象成陷在一锅稀而黏的汤里。

intro.en: Soup first meant bread soaked in broth, not the broth itself.
intro.cn: soup 最初指泡在肉汤里的面包，而不是汤本身。

items.en: Suppa meant a piece of bread soaked in liquid.
items.cn: suppa 指泡在液体里的一块面包。

items.en: Soupe named the soaked bread and then the broth.
items.cn: soupe 先指泡过的面包，后指肉汤。

items.en: Soupe entered English as a thick broth.
items.cn: soupe 以浓汤之义进入英语。

items.en: Soup became the general word for a liquid dish.
items.cn: soup 成为液体菜肴的统称。

items.en: The phrase in the soup added the sense of trouble.
items.cn: 短语 in the soup 增加了「困境」的含义。

note.en: Soup is compared with look-alike words and other liquid dishes.
note.cn: 把 soup 与形近词以及其他汤类菜肴作比较。

entries.definition: a thin soup made with stock

normalIntro.en: Soup is warmth that can be carried in a bowl.
normalIntro.cn: soup 是能盛在碗里端起的温暖。

normal.en: Mother is cooking a pot of hot soup in the kitchen.
normal.cn: 妈妈在厨房煮了一锅热汤。

normal.en: The pumpkin soup was thick and sweet.
Losing his job left him in the soup.

The volunteers run a soup kitchen downtown.
normal.cn: 志愿者在市中心办了一处施粥所。

abstract.en: Soup is the patient cook's answer to cold weather.
abstract.cn: 汤是耐心的厨子对寒冷天气的回答。

abstract.en: A shared pot of soup makes strangers into neighbours.
abstract.cn: 共饮一锅汤，让陌生人变成邻居。

abstract.en: In the soup means the ground has turned to liquid.
abstract.cn: in the soup 意味着脚下的地变成了流质。

examples.en: Mother is cooking a pot of hot soup in the kitchen.
examples.cn: 妈妈在厨房煮了一锅热汤。

examples.en: The pumpkin soup was thick and sweet.
Losing his job left him in the soup.

dict_mnemonic.text: soup 与 soap（肥皂）只差一个字母，注意区分；soupy 是「汤状的」，in the soup 是「陷入困境」，chicken soup 是「鸡汤」。

root: 来自拉丁语 suppa（泡在汤里的面包），经古法语 soupe 进入英语，核心义由「泡面包」转为「汤、羹」。

sensesIntro.en: Soup means a hot liquid dish, a thick broth, or trouble in an idiom.
sensesIntro.cn: soup 指热的液体菜肴、浓羹，以及在习语中表示的困境。

core.en: Ingredients given to water and heat.
core.cn: 交给水和火的食材。

branches.en: Steam rises from a pot on the stove.
branches.cn: 炉上的锅冒出热气。

branches.en: A spoon stands upright in a thick pumpkin soup.
branches.cn: 勺子直立在稠厚的南瓜汤里。

branches.en: A man sinks up to his waist in trouble.
branches.cn: 一个人陷进麻烦，没到腰际。

branches.en: Thin and thick are two textures of one dish.
branches.cn: 稀与稠是同一道菜的两种质地。

branches.en: Something thick and sticky is a good picture of trouble.
branches.cn: 浓稠黏滞之物，正是困境的好写照。

intro.en: Soup forms small adjectives and nouns with -y and -ness.
intro.cn: soup 与 -y、-ness 构成小型形容词和名词。

latinIntro.en: The word goes back to Latin suppa and the verb suppare.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词可追溯到拉丁语 suppa 和动词 suppare。

definition_en: where something comes from, the start of a river, or a person who supplies information
core_image: 山脚下的一股清泉，是所有溪流的起点
scene: 这条消息来自可靠渠道。The news came from a reliable source.
sceneCN: 这里 source 是「消息来源」（第 3 个义项）；句意：这条消息来自可靠渠道。

pos.zh: 消息来源；提供信息的人

senses.title: Where something comes from
senses.definition: the place or thing that something comes from
senses.definitionCN: 某物所来自的地方或事物
senses.example: The sun is a source of energy.
senses.why: This is the general sense behind all the others.
senses.whyCN: 这是贯穿其他义项的一般含义。

senses.title: The start of a river
senses.definition: the place where a river begins
senses.definitionCN: 河流开始的地方
senses.example: The source of the river is in the mountains.
senses.exampleCN: 这条河的源头在群山中。
senses.why: A spring is the clearest image of where things begin.
senses.whyCN: 泉眼是「事物开始之处」最清晰的意象。

senses.title: A supplier of information
senses.definition: a person or document that provides information
senses.definitionCN: 提供信息的人或文件
senses.example: The news came from a reliable source.
senses.exampleCN: 这条消息来自可靠渠道。
senses.why: Information too has a place it flows from.
senses.whyCN: 信息也有它流出的地方。

intro.en: Source first meant a spring of water.
intro.cn: source 最初意为水的泉眼。

items.en: Surgere meant to rise, as water rises from the ground.
items.cn: surgere 意为涌起，如水从地下涌出。

items.en: Sourse named a spring or a rising stream.
items.cn: sourse 指泉眼或涌出的水流。

items.en: Source entered English as the start of a river.
items.cn: source 作为河流的起点进入英语。

items.en: It widened to any origin of a thing.
items.cn: 它扩展到任何事物的起源。

items.en: It came to name people who supply news.
items.cn: 它开始指提供新闻的人。

note.en: Source is compared with look-alike words and words for origins.
note.cn: 把 source 与形近词以及表示起源的词作比较。

entries.definition: the base from which something grows

normalIntro.en: A source is the place a thing flows from.
normalIntro.cn: source 是事物从中流出的地方。

normal.en: The sun is a source of energy.
The source of the river is in the mountains.

examples.en: The sun is a source of energy.

examples.en: The news came from a reliable source.

sensesIntro.en: Source means where something comes from, a river's start, or a supplier of information.
sensesIntro.cn: source 指某物的来源、河流的源头，或信息的提供者。

core.en: The place from which a flow begins.
core.cn: 某种流动开始的地方。

branches.en: Sunlight falls on a wide field.
branches.cn: 阳光洒在广阔的田野上。

branches.en: A spring rises between two rocks.
branches.cn: 一股泉水在岩石间涌出。

branches.en: A reporter writes down a name.

branches.en: Every origin is a kind of spring.
branches.cn: 每一种起源，都是一种泉眼。

branches.en: News flows from people as water flows from rock.
branches.cn: 新闻从人那里流出，如水从岩石中流出。

intro.en: Source forms resource and resourceful, among other words.
intro.cn: source 构成 resource、resourceful 等词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is surgere, to rise up.

items.example: The sun is a source of energy.

definition_en: the direction opposite north, the southern part of an area, or toward the south
core_image: 指南针的红针指向下方，那里是温暖的南方
scene: 燕子冬天飞向南方。The swallows fly south in winter.
sceneCN: 这里 south 是「南方」（第 1 个义项）；句意：燕子冬天飞向南方。

senses.title: The direction
senses.definition: the direction that is opposite north
senses.definitionCN: 与北方相反的方向

senses.title: The southern region

senses.definitionCN: 一个国家或地区的南部

senses.title: Toward the south
senses.definition: in the direction of the south

senses.example: The window faces south.

intro.en: South builds southern, southward, and compass compounds.

definition_en: an empty area, the region beyond the earth, or a gap between things

scene: 这间屋子需要更多空间。This room needs more space.

senses.title: Empty area

senses.example: This room needs more space.

examples.en: This room needs more space.

Leave a space between the lines.

sensesIntro.en: Space means an empty area, the region beyond the earth, or a gap.

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is spatium, an extent or area.

definition_en: to give time or money, to save, to forgive, or kept as extra
core_image: 柜子里放着一把备用钥匙，静静等着需要它的那天
scene: 你能抽出几分钟吗？Can you spare a few minutes?
sceneCN: 这里 spare 是「抽出」（第 1 个义项）；句意：你能抽出几分钟吗？

senses.title: To give time or resources
senses.definition: to be able to give time, money, or effort to someone
senses.definitionCN: 能够把时间、金钱或精力分给别人
senses.example: Can you spare a few minutes?
senses.why: This is the everyday sense of making room for others.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常表示为他人腾出余地的含义。

senses.title: To forgive
senses.definition: to choose not to harm or punish someone
senses.definitionCN: 选择不伤害或惩罚某人
senses.example: The king spared the prisoner.
senses.why: To spare is to hold back the blow.
senses.whyCN: 饶恕，就是把打击收住。

senses.title: Kept as extra
senses.definition: kept in addition in case it is needed
senses.definitionCN: 额外保留以备需要
senses.example: We keep a spare key under the mat.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在垫子下放了一把备用钥匙。

senses.whyCN: 被留出来的东西，就是为以后省下的。

intro.en: Spare first meant to hold back from harming.
intro.cn: spare 最初意为克制不去伤害。

items.cn: sparian 意为不伤害或不使用。

items.en: It came to mean to save or set aside.
items.cn: 它开始表示节省或留出。

items.en: The adjective named what is kept extra.
items.cn: 形容词指额外保留的东西。

items.en: Phrases like spare time fixed the modern uses.
items.cn: spare time 等短语固定了现代用法。

note.en: Spare is compared with look-alike words and words for saving.
note.cn: 把 spare 与形近词以及表示节省、宽恕的词作比较。

normal.en: Can you spare a few minutes?
The king spared the prisoner.
We keep a spare key under the mat.
normal.cn: 我们在垫子下放了一把备用钥匙。

normal.en: He spares no effort in his work.
Spare a thought for those who are cold.

abstract.en: Spare is a word that makes room for mercy.

examples.en: Can you spare a few minutes?
The king spared the prisoner.
We keep a spare key under the mat.
examples.cn: 我们在垫子下放了一把备用钥匙。

branches.cn: 举起来要打的手停住了。

branches.en: A spare key waits under a mat.
branches.cn: 一把备用钥匙等在垫子下。

branches.en: Giving time and giving mercy are both letting go.

branches.en: What is spared is kept for a future need.

definition_en: to say words, to give a speech, or to use a language
core_image: 母亲俯身对孩子轻声说话，孩子仰头认真听着

senses.definition: to say words with your voice
senses.definitionCN: 用嗓音说出词语

senses.whyCN: 这是日常使用嗓音说话的基本含义。

senses.title: To use a language

core_image: 餐桌上点着蜡烛，摆着一份与平日不同的精致晚餐
scene: 今天是个特别的日子。Today is a special day.
sceneCN: 这里 special 是「特别的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：今天是个特别的日子。

senses.title: Out of the ordinary
senses.definition: better or different from what is usual
senses.definitionCN: 比寻常更好或与寻常不同的
senses.example: Today is a special day.
senses.why: This is the everyday sense of something set apart from the ordinary.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常表示某事物不同于寻常的含义。

senses.title: For one purpose
senses.definition: designed or intended for a particular purpose
senses.definitionCN: 为某一特定目的设计或准备的
senses.example: The school has special classes for beginners.
senses.exampleCN: 学校为初学者开设了专门的课程。
senses.why: Something set apart for one purpose is special in a practical sense.
senses.whyCN: 为某一目的单独分出的事物，在实用意义上就是专门的。

senses.title: A dish of the day
senses.definition: a dish or item offered on a particular day at a reduced price
senses.definitionCN: 某日特别供应或降价的菜品、商品
senses.example: Today's special is fish soup.
senses.why: A dish singled out for the day is literally a special.
senses.whyCN: 当日被单独挑出的菜品，字面上就是 special。

intro.en: Special came from Latin through French, meaning of a particular kind.
intro.cn: special 从拉丁语经法语而来，意为属于某一特定种类的。

items.en: Specialis meant belonging to a particular kind.
items.cn: specialis 意为属于某一特定种类的。

items.en: Especial named something distinct or exceptional.
items.cn: especial 指独特或例外的事物。

items.en: Special entered English with the same sense.
items.cn: special 带着同样的含义进入英语。

items.en: It came to mean dear or beloved as well.
items.cn: 它也曾表示珍爱的、心爱的。

items.en: A dish of the day was called the special.
items.cn: 当日的特色菜被称为 the special。

note.en: Special is compared with look-alike words and words for the unusual.
note.cn: 把 special 与形近词以及表示不寻常的词作比较。

entries.definition: the only one of its kind

normalIntro.en: Special marks whatever is singled out from the ordinary.
normalIntro.cn: special 标记从寻常中被单独挑出的事物。

normal.en: Today is a special day.
The school has special classes for beginners.
normal.cn: 学校为初学者开设了专门的课程。

normal.en: Today's special is fish soup.
They gave her special attention.
The shop has a special offer this week.
normal.cn: 这家店本周有特价优惠。

abstract.en: Special is what memory keeps when the rest fades.
abstract.cn: 其余的都淡去了，记忆留下的就是特别。

abstract.en: A day becomes special because someone chose it.
abstract.cn: 日子之所以特别，是因为有人选择了它。

abstract.en: To call a thing special is to set it apart with words.
abstract.cn: 称一物特别，就是用言语把它单独挑出。

examples.en: Today is a special day.
The school has special classes for beginners.
examples.cn: 学校为初学者开设了专门的课程。

examples.en: Today's special is fish soup.

dict_mnemonic.text: special 是「特别的、专门的」，也可作名词指「特色菜、特价品」；specially 是「专门地」，specialty 是「特产、专长」，specialist 是「专家」，specialize 是「专攻」。

root: 来自拉丁语 specialis（属于某一特定种类的），源于 species（种类、外观），核心义为从同类中单独挑出的、特别的。

sensesIntro.en: Special means unusual, intended for one purpose, or a dish singled out for the day.
sensesIntro.cn: special 指非同寻常的、为特定目的准备的，或当日特别供应的菜品。

core.en: Set apart from the rest of its kind.
core.cn: 从同类中被单独分出。

branches.en: A candlelit table stands out from every other night.
branches.cn: 烛光餐桌在每个寻常夜晚中格外显眼。

branches.en: One class is kept for those who are new.
branches.cn: 有一个班专为初学者保留。

branches.en: The cook sets aside one dish for today.
branches.cn: 厨师为今天单独留出一道菜。

branches.en: Both the unusual and the purpose-built are set apart.
branches.cn: 与众不同与专用安排，都是被单独分出。

branches.en: A special class and a special dish are each singled out for a use.
branches.cn: 专门的班级与特供的菜品，都因用途被挑出。

intro.en: Special forms adverbs, nouns, and verbs of focusing.
intro.cn: special 构成副词、名词和表示专注的动词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is species, a kind or appearance, and specialis, of a kind.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁词根是 species（种类、外观）和 specialis（属于某一种类的）。

items.example: The cake was specially made for her.
items.exampleCN: 这蛋糕是专门为她做的。

items.example: Fish soup is the house specialty.
He paid especial attention to detail.

items.exampleCN: 她的拿手甜点是苹果派。

definition_en: a person with deep knowledge of one field, a doctor in one branch of medicine, or a shop dealing in one kind of goods
core_image: 一位医生摘下眼镜，指着心脏影像图向年轻同事讲解
scene: 她是心脏病方面的专家。She is a specialist in heart disease.
sceneCN: 这里 specialist 是「专家」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她是心脏病方面的专家。

senses.title: An expert
senses.definition: a person who knows a great deal about one subject
senses.definitionCN: 对某一学科了解极多的人
senses.example: She is a specialist in heart disease.
senses.exampleCN: 她是心脏病方面的专家。
senses.why: This is the general sense of a person narrowed to one field.
senses.whyCN: 这是把一个人限定在一个领域的通用含义。

senses.title: A medical expert
senses.definition: a doctor trained in one branch of medicine
senses.definitionCN: 受过某一医学分支训练的医生
senses.example: He was referred to a heart specialist.
senses.exampleCN: 他被转诊给一位心脏专科医生。
senses.why: Medicine adopted the word for doctors who limit their practice.
senses.whyCN: 医学界用这个词指限定执业范围的医生。

senses.title: A one-field shop
senses.definition: a shop or firm that deals in one kind of goods
senses.definitionCN: 只经营某一类商品的商店或公司
senses.example: The shop is a specialist in rare books.
senses.why: A business can be a specialist by narrowing what it sells.
senses.whyCN: 商家通过缩小经营范围，也能成为某一领域的专门店。

intro.en: Specialist is special with the suffix for a person devoted to a field.
intro.cn: specialist 是 special 加上表示「专注于某领域的人」的后缀。

items.en: Specialis meant of a particular kind.
items.cn: specialis 意为属于某一特定种类的。

items.en: Spécialiste named one devoted to a single study.
items.cn: spécialiste 指专注于单一学问的人。

items.en: Specialist entered English in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: specialist 于十九世纪进入英语。

items.en: Medicine used it for doctors of one branch.
items.cn: 医学用它指某一分支的医生。

items.en: Shops and firms adopted it for narrow trade.
items.cn: 商店和公司用它表示专营某一类业务。

note.en: Specialist is compared with look-alike words and words for experts.
note.cn: 把 specialist 与形近词以及表示专家的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: A specialist is a person who has chosen one field and gone deep.
normalIntro.cn: specialist 是选定一个领域并深入下去的人。

normal.en: She is a specialist in heart disease.
normal.cn: 她是心脏病方面的专家。

normal.en: He was referred to a heart specialist.
normal.cn: 他被转诊给一位心脏专科医生。

normal.en: The shop is a specialist in rare books.
The team hired a computer specialist.
normal.cn: 团队聘请了一位计算机专家。

normal.en: Specialist training takes many years.

abstract.en: To specialize is to trade width for depth.
abstract.cn: 专精，是用广度换深度。

abstract.en: Every specialist was once a curious beginner.
abstract.cn: 每位专家都曾是好奇的初学者。

abstract.en: The narrower the field, the deeper the well.
abstract.cn: 领域越窄，井就越深。

examples.en: She is a specialist in heart disease.
examples.cn: 她是心脏病方面的专家。

examples.en: He was referred to a heart specialist.
examples.cn: 他被转诊给一位心脏专科医生。

examples.en: The shop is a specialist in rare books.

dict_mnemonic.text: specialist 由 special 加 -ist 构成，指「专注于某一领域的人」，即专家、专科医生；动词 specialize 是「专攻」，名词 specialization 是「专业化」，specialist in 是「……方面的专家」。

root: 由拉丁语 specialis（特定种类的）加希腊来源的后缀 -ist（从事者）构成，指专注于某一领域的人，后特指专科医生。

sensesIntro.en: Specialist means an expert in one field, a doctor of one branch, or a shop dealing in one kind of goods.
sensesIntro.cn: specialist 指某一领域的专家、某一医学分支的专科医生，或专营某类商品的商店。

core.en: A person or business narrowed to one field.
core.cn: 收窄到一个领域的人或机构。

branches.en: One mind holds a single subject in depth.
branches.cn: 一个人深入掌握一门学问。

branches.en: A doctor studies only the heart.
branches.cn: 一位医生只研究心脏。

branches.en: A small shop sells only rare books.
branches.cn: 一家小店只卖珍本书。

branches.en: The expert and the doctor both earn trust through depth.
branches.cn: 专家与医生都凭深度赢得信任。

branches.en: A narrow practice can belong to a person or a shop.
branches.cn: 专精的领域可以属于一个人，也可以属于一家店。

intro.en: Specialist connects to verbs and nouns of narrowing focus.
intro.cn: specialist 与表示聚焦的动词和名词相连。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is specialis, of a particular kind, from species, a kind.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁词根是 specialis（特定种类的），源于 species（种类）。

items.example: She is a specialist in heart disease.
items.exampleCN: 她是心脏病方面的专家。
这家医院有许多专科医生。
她的专业领域是古钱币。

items.example: Fish soup is the house specialty.
The cake was specially made for her.
items.exampleCN: 这蛋糕是专门为她做的。
